Description

Feeling weakness, numbness, tingling, or low strength in your hands and legs? In this informative health video, Dr. Shagufta explains possible reasons behind nerve weakness and discusses simple natural remedies, healthy food habits, and lifestyle tips that may support nerve health.

She also explains how certain everyday nutritional habits may help the body maintain healthy nerve function and why persistent symptoms should not be ignored.

Watch the full video to learn:
• Common causes of nerve weakness
• Symptoms associated with weak nerves
• Natural ways to support nerve health
• Foods and drinks that may support the nervous system
• Lifestyle habits for better overall health
• When you should consult a doctor

This video is for educational and awareness purposes only. Natural remedies are not a substitute for professional medical diagnosis or treatment. If you have persistent numbness, weakness, severe pain, or other neurological symptoms, consult a qualified healthcare professional.

Simple habits that may support better sleep
Traditional uses of ghee in bedtime routines
